يتجاهلن (form VI)
# يَتَجَاهَلْنَ (yatajāhalna) /ja.ta.d͡ʒaː.hal.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَجَاهَلَ (tajāhala)
# يُتَجَاهَلْنَ (yutajāhalna) /ju.ta.d͡ʒaː.hal.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَجَاهَلَ (tajāhala)
